name: Election Fulcrum
desc: An online election system for candidate registration, document verification and election administration.
overview: The application brings candidate records and verification into a single administrative workflow. Its design includes separate credentials for candidates and voters.

name: Hotel Management System
desc: A hotel operations project connecting front-desk tasks with housekeeping workflows.
overview: The project covers check-in and check-out, room assignments and room-status updates for housekeeping staff.

name: Children’s Mental Health Website
desc: An educational website bringing mental health awareness resources and wellbeing videos together.
overview: The site organizes introductory reading, yoga tips and videos in one place for visitors exploring mental wellbeing.

name: Children’s Mental Health Application
desc: A questionnaire-based application exploring anxiety, depression and stress.
overview: The application groups self-reported responses by topic. The project focuses on the questionnaire experience and the organization of responses.

name: Personal Portfolio
desc: An earlier edition of my personal site, presenting my development work and experience.
overview: This edition collected project previews, technology skills and career information in a static portfolio.
